Dimension.name: $~paimaish
doc: $~Main /paimaish ki ikai/ hoon!
Main koi bhi muqarrara ikai ho sakti hoon, jaise \1m\, \10s\, \100g\, ya koi aur science ki ikai. Main woh bhi ban sakti hoon jo aap khud banayein, jaise \17apple\.
Mujhe \/\ ke saath jod kar nisbat wali ikaiyan ban sakti hain jaise \17apple/day\, aur \^\ ke saath taaqat wali ikaiyan jaise \9.8m/s^2\
Main hamesha @Number ke baad aati hoon. Agar aisa na ho to mujhe @Reference samjha ja sakta hai, aur yeh bohat sharmindagi ki baat hogi!
Main ikaiyon ke beech ghalti dhoondne mein bhi achhi hoon. Misal ke taur par, \1cat + 1dog\🪲 ka koi matlab nahin banta!
Agar aap ikaiyon ki alag alag @values ke beech badalna chahein to @Convert se baat karein.

Language.name: $~zubaan
doc: $~Main ek @language tag hoon aur @Name aur @Doc ke saath kaam karta hoon!
Main yeh bilkul saaf kar deta hoon ke koi cheez kis zubaan mein likhi hai. Bas ek chhoti si slash aur do teen harf, aur kisi ko kabhi uljhan nahin hogi ke matn kis zubaan mein hai.
Misaal ke taur par, agar aap "Language" likhna chahte hain aur saaf karna chahte hain ke yeh angrezi mein hai:
\'Zubaan'/ur\
Aap yeh @Name ke liye kar sakte hain:
\aawaaz: 'myaaon'\🪲
…ya @Doc ke liye:

\¶Aawaaz ki naqal wale alfaaz¶
aawaaz: 'myaaon'\🪲

Kabhi kabhi matn sirf ek zubaan mein nahin hota — woh *milaa hua* hota hai. Jaise Spanglish, jahan hispaani aur angrezi mil jaati hain. Aisi surat mein har zubaan ko underscore ke saath likhein. Pehli zubaan *asal* hoti hai — jab mujhe koi ek chunni ho (maslan, kaun se iqtibaas ke nishaan istemaal karne hain), to main wohi chunta hoon.
\"Hola gentleman!"/es_en\

\¶Do zubaanon mein salaam¶
salaam: 'Hola gentleman!'\🪲

Mila hua tag batata hai ke poora matn milaa hua hai, is liye screen reader ya @Say sab kuch asal zubaan mein parhta hai. Agar har lafz apni zubaan mein parha jaye, to lafzon ko alag alag tag karein aur unhein jod dein:
\"Hola "/es + 'gentleman!'/ur\
Aap ek @region bhi dash ke baad likh sakte hain, bilkul ek zubaan ki tarah:
\"Hola gentleman!"/es_en-MX\
Zubaanon ki koi had nahin — bas ek hi zubaan do baar na likhein; agar aap ne aisa kiya to main bata doonga.

Aap zubaan ko uske <2 harf ke code@https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes> se ya uske *naam* se likh sakte hain, us zubaan mein ya angrezi mein — `/es`, `/Español`, aur `/Spanish` sab ka matlab ek hi hai, aur `/es-MX`, `/es-México`, aur `/es-Mexico` ka bhi. Bade chhote harf aur zer zabar ka farq nahin padta, is liye `/ESPANOL` bhi chalta hai. Jis naam mein @placeholder ho, use khaali jagah ke baghair likhein, jaise `/BahasaIndonesia`, kyunke tag ek hi lafz hota hai. Agar main kisi zubaan ya ilaaqe ko na pehchanoon, to aap ko bata doonga.

doc: $~Main Verse ke kirdaar ka link hoon. Aap @Doc likhna chahein aur hum mein se kisi ka zikr karna chahein, to main aap ki madad karta hoon.
Misaal ke taur par, farz karein aap @Evaluate ke baare mein baat karna chahte hain. Aap batana chahte hain ke woh kitne zabardast hain. Aap yeh likh sakte hain:

Har kirdaar ka ek Unicode number bhi hota hai. Misaal ke taur par, @FunctionDefinition ka number 192 hai. Aap kisi bhi Unicode kirdaar ka zikr kar sakte hain. Bas @U/ aur us ka number likhein, aur woh nazar aa jayega:

BinaryEvaluate.name: $~do-tarfa chalana
doc: $~Main @Evaluate hoon, lekin ek aasaan shakal mein, jo us waqt kaam aati hai jab aap aisa @FunctionDefinition istemaal karna chahein jo do input leta hai.
Misaal ke taur par, do adad jama karne ke liye aap @Evaluate is tarah istemaal kar sakte hain:
Kya yeh thoda ajeeb nahin lagta? Yeh ghalat nahin hai: yeh sirf kehta hai ke 1 par jama karne wala function lein aur phir use chalayein.
Lekin @BinaryEvaluate istemaal karna bahut aasaan hai
Is se sab kuch thoda saaf ho jaata hai, halanke yeh asal mein ek hi baat hai.
Sirf ek baat ka khayal rakhein: jab main is shakal mein hota hoon, to main baayein se daayein taraf chalta hoon. Agar aap riyaazi ke amal ki tarteeb ke aadi hain to yeh uljhan paida kar sakta hai.
Is ka matlab hai ke yeh us tarah chalta hai jis ki aap ummeed nahin karte:
Riyaazi mein pehle zarb aati, phir jama, aur is liye nateeja \11\ hota. Lekin chunke main parhne ki tarteeb mein chalta hoon, nateeja \13\ hai.

Bind.name: $~bandhna
doc: $~Main *qeematon* ko naam deta hoon.
Is tarah!
Main @FunctionDefinition aur @StructureDefinition ke inputs ko naam deta hoon, aur @Block mein qeematon ko naam deta hoon. Main har cheez ko naam deta hoon!
Lekin kya aap jaante hain ke ek qeemat ke *kayi naam* ho sakte hain?
Mujhe yeh batate hue bohat khushi ho rahi hai! Ek @value, kayi @Names. Misaal ke taur par:
Dekha, maine yahan kya kiya?
Ek qeemat, teen naam.
Aap us paanch ko in mein se *kisi bhi* naam se pukaar sakte hain.
Yeh tab khaas taur par kaam aata hai jab aap kayi @languages mein naam dena chahein:
Dekha, maine yahan kya kiya? Ek qeemat ke teen naam, bas alag alag zubaanon mein!
Theek hai, ab mera aakhri raaz.
Kya aap jaante hain ke main @Is ke saath kaam kar sakta hoon taake mujhe bata sakein ke kisi naam ki qeemat kis qism ki honi chahiye? Aur agar woh na ho, to main aap ko bata doonga?
Is tarah:
\badaAdad•#: 'ek zillion'\🪲
Dekhein, maine kaha \bignumber\ number hona chahiye, lekin woh matn hai, aur yeh dono aapas mein mel nahin khaate, is liye BOOM!
Agar woh ek doosre se na milein to main aap ko bata doonga.
Kabhi kabhi aap ko mujhe *batana* parta hai ke koi cheez kis qism ka data hai, kyunke main khud nahin samajh sakta. Aisa aksar @FunctionDefinition mein hota hai.
Misaal ke taur par, yahan @FunctionDefinition nahin jaanta ke \a\ aur \b\ ki qeematein kis qism ki hain, kyunke maine unhein bataya nahin.
\ƒ majmooa(a2 b2) a2 + b2\🪲
Lekin hum ise badal kar @Is shamil kar sakte hain, aur ab @FunctionDefinition jaan jaata hai ke woh numbers hain:
\ƒ majmooa(a2•# b2•#) a2 + b2\

Conditional.name: $~shart wala
doc: $~Kya main aapko ek @value doon ya doosra, ek @condition ke hisaab se? Kuch is tarah?

\adad: -100
adad < 0 ? 'manfi' 'musbat'\
Lekin kya aapne kabhi socha hai ke hum faisla kaise karte hain?
Kya aisa nahin lagta ke faislay sirf haan ya na se zyada gehre hone chahiye? Kya \⊤\ aur \⊥\ ke beech chunna hi sab kuch hai?
Kya aapko fikr nahin ke agar hum sirf isi tarah ke faislay kar sakte hain, to hum duniya ke baare mein kuch zaroori baatein kho denge?

Ek aur kaam hai jo main karta hoon, aur mujhe uska hamesha shukriya nahin milta. Jab mera @condition poochta hai ke koi qeemat kis /qism/ ki hai, to main sirf haan ya na mein jawab nahin deta. Main apne har intikhaab ke andar woh jawab yaad rakhta hoon.

\jasaamat•#|'': 5
jasaamat•# ? jasaamat + 1 'bohat chhota'\

Akeli hone par, woh qeemat ek @Number ya kuch @Text ho sakti hai, aur us mein kuch jodna ek @conflict hoga, kyunke yeh bahut mukhtalif tareeqon se jode jaate hain. Lekin mere /yes/ ke andar hum ne abhi poocha hai ke kya yeh @Number hai, is liye wahan yeh woh hi hai. Mere /nahin/ ke andar, yeh @Text hai.

Farq nahin padta ke aap kaise poochte hain. Qism ki jaanch, kisi khaas qeemat se muqabla, ghayab qeemat ki jaanch, aur kisi naam se mehfooz ki hui jaanch, sab mujhe ek hi baat batate hain. Aur @Boolean/and, @Boolean/or, aur @Boolean/not unhein waise hi milate hain jaise aap umeed karte hain.

Do cheezein hain jo main aapko nahin bata sakta. Agar aap @Text se muqabla karte hain jis ke kai tarjume hain, to main kuch nahin seekhta, kyunke aapko kaun sa tarjuma milega yeh is par hai ke kaun parh raha hai.

Dekha, main ne billiyon ko cats mein kaise badal diya? Zabardast!

Translate.name: $~tarjuma karein
doc: $~Main majmue ki HAR cheez ke saath ek hi kaam karta hoon! WAH WAH WAH! Main yehi to karta hoon!!
Apna majmua meri baaein taraf rakhein, mera teer \↦\ banayein, phir meri daaein taraf likhein ke har cheez KIS MEIN BADAL jaye — @This ka matlab hai woh cheez jo main ABHI pakde hue hoon!
\[1 2 3] ↦ ⬚ + 1\ aapko \[2 3 4]\ deta hai. DHAMAKA! Har number mein ek ka izafa, na chakkar, na @FunctionDefinition, na koi jhanjhat!
Main data se @Phrase output banane ke liye BEHTAREEN hoon! Naamon ki list hai? \['Ada' 'Mac' 'Tim'] ↦ Phrase(⬚)\ aur ab HAR naam ke liye ek jumla ban gaya!!
Main @List, @Set, @Map (main naqshe ki @VALUES badalta hoon — kunjiyan apni jagah rehti hain!), aur @Table par bhi chalta hoon!

Kuch aur khaas chahiye — jaise har cheez ka @index, ya aisa function jo kayi jagah dobara istemaal ho? Mere zyada thande, samajhdaar rishtedaaron ke paas jayein, jaise @List.translate. Lekin rozmarra ke tez mapping ke liye main hazir hoon!!
Translate.start: $~Ruko, main $expression ki sab cheezein utha leta hoon!
Translate.finish: $~LO JI! Yeh raha aapka bilkul naya majmua: $value

doc: $~Main apne pyaare @FunctionDefinition ko chalata hoon, use @argument deta hoon aur uske qadam follow karta hoon. Hi! Is tarah:

\ƒ salaam(paigham•'')
	salaam('billi')\🪲
Functions kahin se bhi aa sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, @Text mein functions hain. Is tarah:
\'billi'.length()\
Agar kisi function ka naam sirf ek nishaan ka ho, to aap mujhe @BinaryEvaluate ki tarah likh sakte hain.
\'billi' ⊆ 'chhoti si'\
Yeh bilkul usi ke barabar hai:
\'billi'.⊆('chhoti si')\
Haan, main @FunctionDefinition ke baghair kuch nahin. Main bas unhein daleel deta hoon aur unke qadam follow karta hoon.
Darasal, mere paas kuch apni salaahiyatein bhi hain. Misaal ke taur par, agar @FunctionDefinition ki daleel @Boolean ho, to aap @value dene ke bajaye sirf uska naam likh kar use chalu kar sakte hain.

Input.name: $~Input
doc: $~Main ek input hoon jo @Evaluate ko diya gaya hai. Mera naam @FunctionDefinition ya @StructureDefinition ke input ke naam se milta hai jo chalaya ja raha hai.
Main un functions mein madadgaar hoon jin ke bohot se default @values hote hain, jahan aap sirf ek khaas input badalna chahte hain aur baaqi sab kuch nahin dena chahte.

Misaal ke taur par, @Phrase ke style ko qaboo karne ke liye bohot saari default qeematein hain. Farz karein aap kuch @Text aur ek @Color dena chahte hain, lekin input list mein aur kuch nahin. Aap yeh karne ke liye mujhe istemaal kar sakte hain:
\Phrase('Main jamni hoon!' rang: Color(50% 52 300°))\

Hum kya jod rahe hain? Mujhe nahin pata. Aap batayein.

FunctionDefinition.name: $~function
doc: $~Main kuch inputs leta hoon, phir unhein istemaal kar ke ek @expression chalata hoon aur ek output deta hoon. Phir se salaam!
Yeh ek aasaan misaal hai:

\ƒ dohrao(paigham•'') paigham × 5
dohrao('hi')\
Yeh function ek input leta hai, \message\, aur @Text.repeat function se paigham paanch baar dohrata hai.
Main tab bohot madadgaar hoon jab aap kisi cheez ko baar baar chalana chahte hon, lekin alag alag inputs ke saath!
Mere paas aur bhi kai chhote tareeqe hain. Misaal ke taur par, mera naam hona zaroori nahin. Yahan, main seedha @Evaluate ko ek @value ke taur par ja raha hoon.
\(ƒ(paigham•'') paigham × 5)('hi')\
Ya, yeh ek function hai jo input ke naam ke baad \…\ nishaan istemaal kar ke kitne bhi inputs le sakta hai.

\ƒ haan(paighamaat…•'') paighamaat.sans('nahin')
haan('haan' 'haan' 'nahin' 'haan' 'nahin')\
Dekha, isne saare 'no' le kar hata diye? Is liye ke messages ek @List hai, aur hum @List.sansAll istemaal kar sakte the.
Kabhi kabhi aap saaf batana chahte hon ke main kis qism ki qeemat deta hoon. Iske liye, inputs ki list ke baad ek @Is likhein:
\ƒ shamilKarein(x2•# y2•#)•'' x2 + y2\🪲
Aapko is mein ek @conflict nazar aayega: yeh kehta hai ke yeh @Text par khatam hota hai, lekin yeh do @Number leta hai. Main bata sakta hoon jab cheezein aapas mein mel nahin khatin!
Bilkul, @Evaluate ke baghair main waqai kaam ka nahin hoon; wohi mujhe zinda karte hain.

Initial.name: $~aaghaz

\◆ ? Time() 'hi'\
Aap ne dekha nahin, lekin pehla daur ek waqt tha, phir aane wali har tik par main \⊥\ tha, is liye @Conditional ne \⊤\ banaya.
Main bohat madadgaar hoon agar aap @stream ke saath kaam kar rahe hain aur sirf pehli baar kuch karna chahte hain -- ya pehli baar kabhi nahin!

Insert.name: $~daalna
doc: $~Main @Table mein ek nayi row jodta hoon. Kya aap ne kabhi dekha hai ke table mein kuch kami lagti hai? Main woh daal sakta hoon!
Sochein ke aap ke paas ek khel ke khilaadiyon ka table hai aur aap ek naya khilaadi daalna chahte hain:

\khilari: ⎡naam•'' team•'' nuqtay•#⎦
	⎡'jen' 'laal' 1⎦
	⎡'joan' 'neela' 0⎦
	⎡'jeff' 'laal' 3⎦
	⎡'janet' 'neela' 2⎦
khilari ⎡+'jason' 'laal' 0⎦\

Bas yaad rakhein, Verse ki har cheez ki tarah, main table ko badalta nahin, balki uski nayi shakal banata hoon. Is liye aap ko tay karna hoga ke nayi shakal kahan rakhni hai. Aksar aap @Reaction mein kisi input ke liye table ki nayi shakal banayenge aur @Bind mein rakhenge.
Insert.finish: $~Maine nayi rows ke saath ek naya table banaya!

Misaal ke taur par, farz karein aap ke paas ek anjaani qeemat hai. Main bata sakta hoon ke woh @Number hai ya nahin, aur aap ko @Boolean milta hai:

doc: $~Main aapke banaye hue matn par ek zubaan lagata hoon, taake badalne ke baad bhi uski @language barqarar rahe. Is tarah:
\('salaam' + "!")/en\
Zyadatar matn ke kaam pehle hi zubaan ko barqarar rakhte hain, lekin jab aap khud zubaan chunna chahein to main madad karta hoon.
Main sirf matn par kaam karta hoon, is liye mujhe matn hi dein!
Localized.start: $~Pehle $value ko chalate hain, phir us par zubaan ka nishaan lagate hain…

Spread.name: $~phailao
doc: $~Main doosri listein ke @values se ek @List banane mein madad karta hoon. Is tarah:

\fehrist: [1 2 3]
aakhri: [:fehrist 4 5 6]\🪲

PatternLiteral.name: $~namoona
doc: $~Main ek namoona hoon! Main matn ki *shakal* batata hoon, theek alfaaz nahin. Is liye aap \≈\ se jaanch sakte hain ke kya poora matn fit hota hai, ya \⌕\ se woh sab jagahein dhoondh sakte hain jahan yeh shakal aati hai. @query @Result ki ek list wapas deti hai.
Yeh dekhein, nashte ke baare mein ek jumle mein khaane ke alfaaz dhoondhna:

\naashta: 'naashte mein mainne anday, toast, aur santre ka juice liya'
naashta ⌕ ⣿ "eggs" | "toast" | "juice" | "pancakes"⣿\

Mujhe baayein se daayein padhein. Ek @PatternClass ek qism ka ek harf milata hai: \⣿◌⣿\ koi bhi, \⣿_⣿\ ek harf, \⣿#⣿\ ek ankh, \⣿␣⣿\ ek @placeholder. Qauson mein matn ek @PatternLiteralText hai jo bilkul wahi milata hai, jaise \⣿"-"⣿\. Baaqi \⣿…⣿\ — ek @PatternRest — kitne bhi harf milata hai.

Ginti pehle aati hai. Ek @PatternQuantified agle hisse ko ek @PatternQuantifier se dohrata hai: \⣿3 #⣿\ teen ankh, \⣿3–5 #⣿\ teen se paanch, \⣿>0 #⣿\ ek ya zyada, \⣿≥0 #⣿\ sifar ya zyada, \⣿≤1 #⣿\ marzi ka.
Hisson ko @PatternGroup se jama karein, aur @PatternSequence mein intekhaab dein, jaise \⣿(◌ | #)⣿\. Sab se lamba milne wala intekhaab jeet'ta hai.
Ek @PatternSet ek set se ek harf milata hai, aur ek @PatternRange harfon ke silsile milata hai, jaise \⣿ {"a"–"z" #}⣿\. Kisi hisse ko @PatternComplement se ulta karein, jaise \⣿~#⣿\.
Kisi qism ko @PatternProperty se mazeed tang karein, jaise Yunaani harf ke liye \⣿ _/greek⣿\ ya \⣿ ◌/emoji⣿\.

Kisi hisse ko @PatternCapture se naam dein, jaise \⣿ year: (4 #)⣿\, phir baad mein sirf uska naam likh kar @PatternBackref se dobara istemaal karein. Har @Result pakde gaye hisse naam ke saath batata hai.
Kinaron se @PatternAnchor se jodein: \⣿⊢⣿\ aaghaz, \⣿⊣⣿\ ikhtitaam. Bina khaye jhaank'na @PatternLook se karein: \⣿▸(#)⣿\ aage, \⣿◂(#)⣿\ peeche.

Poore alfaaz @PatternWord \⣿ ▭/en⣿\ se milayein ya lafz ki hadein @PatternWordEdge \⣿ ┊/en⣿\ se, jo @language ke liye baanti jaati hain. @PatternCaseFold \⣿ Aa("hi")⣿\ ke andar harf ke bade chhote hone ko nazarandaaz karein.
Mera @type ek @PatternType hai — kisi naam par ise lagayein, jaise \p•⣿⣿: ⣿ ◌⣿\🪲 — taake aap mujhe ek naam mein rakh kar bahut se matn par dobara istemaal kar sakein.
PatternLiteral.start: $~Dekhte hain yeh matn kaisa dikhta hai.

step.search: $~Is matn mein woh sab jagahein dhoondhte hain jahan yeh namoona aata hai.
step.test: $~Jaanchte hain ke kya poora matn is namoone se milta hai.
step.scan: $~Namoone ko maqam $position se dhoondh rahe hain.
step.end: $~$pattern ko abhi ek harf chahiye, lekin hum maqam $position par matn ke aakhir tak pahunch gaye hain.
step.repeat: $~$pattern ne $count ko milaya — aage badhne ke liye kaafi.
step.short: $~$pattern sirf $count baar mela — yeh kaafi nahin hai.

EmptyPattern.name: $~khaali pattern
EmptyPattern.explanation: $~Mere koi hisse nahin hain, is liye main kisi kaam ki cheez se nahin melta. Kya aap koi hissa shaamil kar sakte hain?
EmptyPattern.resolution: $~Koi bhi ek harf milane ke liye \◌\ shaamil karein

PatternSequence.name: $~silsila
doc: $~Main pattern ke hisson ki ek qataar hoon, jo ek ke baad ek, baayen se daayen taraf milaye jaate hain.
Misaal ke taur par, phone number ki shakal dekhein — teen ankre, ek dash, phir chaar:
Aap mujhe intikhaab de sakte hain aur main jo bhi fit ho woh le leta hoon, sab se lamba pasand karta hoon, jaise \⣿ "cat" | "dog"⣿\.

OverlappingAlternatives.name: $~ek doosre mein aane wale intikhaab
OverlappingAlternatives.explanation: $~$shorter, $longer ka shuruaati hissa hai, aur sab se lamba intikhaab hamesha jeet-ta hai, is liye $shorter sirf tab melta hai jab $longer nahin mel sakta. Kya aap yeh kehna chahte the?

PatternClass.name: $~harf ki jamaat
doc: $~Main ek qism ka sirf ek harf milata hoon: \⣿◌⣿\ koi bhi grapheme, \⣿_⣿\ ek harf, \⣿#⣿\ ek ankra, \⣿␣⣿\ ek @placeholder.
Misaal ke taur par, ek fehrist mein se har harf-phir-ankra @code nikaalein:

\code: 'a1 b2 c3'
code ⌕ ⣿ _ #⣿\
Mujhe \⣿>0 #⣿\ (ek ya zyada ankre) jaise quantifier se ginein, ya @property jaise \⣿ _/greek⣿\ (ek Yooni harf) se mujhe tang karein.

PatternProperty.name: $~khaasiyat
doc: $~Main harf ki jamaat ko ek Unicode @property tak mehdood kar deta hoon. Ek rasm-ul-khat istemaal karein, jaise \⣿ _/greek⣿\, \⣿ _/han⣿\, ya \⣿ _/arabic⣿\.
Misaal ke taur par, mile-jule matn mein Yooni harfon ka silsila dhoondein:

\matn: 'hello αβγ duniya'
matn ⌕ ⣿ >0 _/greek⣿\
Ya ek zumra, jaise \⣿ ◌/punctuation⣿\, \⣿ ◌/currency⣿\, \⣿ ◌/Nd⣿\ (ek ankra), ya \⣿ _/Lu⣿\ (ek bara harf).
Ya haan-ya-nahin wali khaasiyat, jaise \⣿ ◌/emoji⣿\ ya \⣿ _/uppercase⣿\ — aur aap kisi ek ko naam aur @value ke saath likh sakte hain, jaise \⣿ ◌/Script=Greek⣿\.
Kisi khaasiyat ko @PatternComplement se nikaal dein, jaise \⣿ ~◌/emoji⣿\ (har woh cheez jo emoji nahin hai).

UnrecognizedPatternProperty.name: $~nama-maaloom khaasiyat
UnrecognizedPatternProperty.explanation: $~Main khaasiyat $name ko nahin pehchanta. Koi zumra, rasm-ul-khat, ya Unicode id aazmaein.

PatternQuantifier.name: $~quantifier
doc: $~Main batata hoon ke kitni baar milana hai: ek durust \⣿3 #⣿\, ek daayra \⣿3–5 #⣿\, \⣿=3 #⣿\ (theek teen), \⣿>0 #⣿\ (ek ya zyada), \⣿≥0 #⣿\ (sifar ya zyada), \⣿<5 #⣿\ (paanch se kam), \⣿≤1 #⣿\ (marzi ka).
Misaal ke taur par, ek jumle mein ankron ka har silsila dhoondein:

\matn: 'mere paas 3 billiyan aur 12 machhliyan hain'
matn ⌕ ⣿ >0 #⣿\
Main hamesha us hisse se pehle aata hoon jise main ginta hoon, jaise \⣿3 #⣿\ ya \⣿>0 _⣿\.

MalformedQuantifier.name: $~na-mumkin ginti
MalformedQuantifier.explanation: $~Meri kam se kam ginti meri zyada se zyada ginti se bari hai, is liye main kabhi nahin mel sakta.
MalformedQuantifier.resolution: $~Meri gintiyan badal dein taake chhoti pehle aaye

PatternQuantified.name: $~dohraav
doc: $~Main agle hisse ko kayi baar milata hoon.
Misaal ke taur par, dekhein ke ZIP @code theek paanch ankon ka hai ya nahin:

Isay ek jamaat jaise \⣿3 #⣿\ (teen ank) ke saath gintein, ya ek group jaise \⣿ 2 ("ab")⣿\ (do "ab"), ya ek ulta jaise \⣿2 ~#⣿\ (do gair-ank). \⣿>0 #⣿\ ke saath main laalchi hoon — jitne ho sakein utne le leta hoon.

PatternCapture.name: $~pakadna
doc: $~Main milan ke ek hisse ko naam deta hoon taake aap usay har @Result se wapas parh sakein.
Misaal ke taur par, tareekh se saal, mahina aur din nikaalein:
Jo main ne pakda woh baad mein dobara istemaal karne ke liye mera naam phir likhein — dekhein @PatternBackref — jaise \⣿ w: (>0 _) ␣ w⣿\ jo dohra lafz dhoondta hai.

DuplicateCaptureName.name: $~dohra pakadna
DuplicateCaptureName.explanation: $~Ek aur pakadna pehle se $name naam istemaal kar raha hai, is liye yeh usay mita dega.
DuplicateCaptureName.resolution: $~Is pakadne ka naam badal kar $replacement kar dein

PatternComplement.name: $~nahin
doc: $~Main ek aisa grapheme milata hoon jo aage wali cheez NAHIN hai. Jamaat ko ulta karein jaise \⣿~#⣿\ (ank nahin), ya set ko jaise \⣿~{":" ␣}⣿\ (na colon na @placeholder).
Misaal ke taur par, colon ke aas paas ke @key aur @value nikaalein, aisi lakeeron ko milakar jo na colon hon na khaali jagah:

\jora: 'rang: neela'
jora ⌕ ⣿ >0 ~{":" ␣}⣿\
Group ko ulta karein jaise \⣿~(◌ | #)⣿\, ya @property ko jaise \⣿ ~◌/emoji⣿\ (emoji nahin).
Mujhe @PatternLook se pehle rakh kar ulta karein: \⣿~▸(#)⣿\ ka matlab hai "aage ank nahin", aur \⣿~◂("$")⣿\ ka matlab hai "pehle dollar ka nishaan nahin".

PatternGroup.name: $~group
doc: $~Main hisson ko ek saath bandhta hoon taake gintee ya intikhaab un sab par lagu ho. Main kabhi pakadta nahin; pakadne ke liye @PatternCapture se hisse ko naam dein.
Misaal ke taur par, dekhein ke matn "ab" ka dohraya hua hissa hai ya nahin:

\naara: 'ababab'
naara ≈ ⣿ >0 ("ab")⣿\
Group ko ginein jaise \⣿ 2 ("ab")⣿\ (do "ab") ya intikhaab dein jaise \⣿(◌ | #)⣿\ (harf ya ank).

PatternSet.name: $~harf ka set
doc: $~Main ikhtiyaaraat ke set mein se koi bhi ek grapheme milata hoon.
Misaal ke taur par, ek lafz mein harakaat dhoondein:

\lafz: 'salaam'
lafz ⌕ ⣿ {"a" "e" "i" "o" "u"}⣿\
Hadd aur jamaatein milayein, jaise \⣿ {"a"–"z" #}⣿\ ya \⣿ {# "a"–"f"}⣿\ (ek hex ank). @PatternComplement se mujhe ulta karein, jaise \⣿~{"!" "?"}⣿\.

PatternRange.name: $~hadd
doc: $~Main do sirron ke darmiyan scalar tarteeb se ek grapheme milata hoon, aur main @PatternSet ke andar rehta hoon.
Misaal ke taur par, matn mein se chhote harfon wale alfaaz nikaalein:

\matn: 'hello duniya 2026'
matn ⌕ ⣿ >0 {"a"–"z"}⣿\
Harf jaise \⣿ {"a"–"z" "A"–"Z"}⣿\ ya ank jaise \⣿{"0"–"9"}⣿\ kisi bhi rasm-ul-khat mein ginein, jaise \⣿ {"あ"–"ん"}⣿\.

PatternLiteralText.name: $~haqeeqi matn
doc: $~Main bilkul wohi matn milata hoon jo mere ineqtibaas mein hai, koi khaas matlab nahin.
Misaal ke taur par, ek jumle mein dollar ki raqam dhoondein:

\raseed: 'yeh aaj $5 ka hai'
raseed ⌕ ⣿ "$" >0 #⣿\
Mujhe tay shuda hisson ke liye istemaal karein jaise \⣿"-"⣿\, \⣿"@"⣿\, ya poora lafz \⣿ "cat"⣿\, doosre hisson ke saath jorrkar, jaise phone number ke liye \⣿3 # "-" 4 #⣿\.

PatternAnchor.name: $~lunger
doc: $~Main matn ka ek kinara milata hoon bina kuch khaye: \⣿⊢⣿\ shuru, \⣿⊣⣿\ aakhir.
Misaal ke taur par, dekhein ke salaam "Hello" se shuru hota hai ya nahin:

\salaam: 'Salaam duniya'
salaam ≈ ⣿ ⊢ "Hello" …⣿\
Maqam tay karein, jaise \⣿ ⊢ "Hi"⣿\ ("Hi" se shuru), \⣿"." ⊣⣿\ (full stop par khatam), ya \⣿⊢ _ ⊣⣿\ (poora matn bas ek harf hai).

PatternWord.name: $~lafz
doc: $~Main poora lafz milata hoon, jo @language ke apne usoolon se milta hai.
Misaal ke taur par, ek jumle ke alfaaz ki fehrist banayein:

\jumla: 'billi baithi'
jumla ⌕ ⣿ ▭/en⣿\
Zubaan ka naam likhein, jaise angrezi ke liye \⣿ ▭/en⣿\ ya cheeni ke liye \⣿ ▭/zh⣿\, aur kisi khaas lafz ko kinaaron se bandhein, jaise \⣿ ┊/en "cat" ┊/en⣿\.

MissingPatternLocale.name: $~zubaan ghaayab hai
MissingPatternLocale.explanation: $~Alfaaz dhoondne ke liye mujhe ek zubaan chahiye. Kya aap ek shaamil kar sakte hain, jaise \/en\?

PatternWordEdge.name: $~lafz ka kinara
doc: $~Main @language ke liye lafz ki hadd milata hoon, bina kuch khaye.
Misaal ke taur par, "cat" ko poore lafz ke taur par dhoondein, "category" ke andar nahin:

\matn: 'ek billi ek qism mein'
matn ⌕ ⣿ ┊/en "cat" ┊/en⣿\
Kisi lafz ko mujh se gher dein, jaise \⣿ ┊/en "cat" ┊/en⣿\, taake woh sirf poora milay.

PatternLook.name: $~aas paas ki jaanch
doc: $~Main dekhta hoon ke abhi aage \⣿▸(#)⣿\ ya peechhe \⣿◂(#)⣿\ kya hai, bina usay khaye, taake agla hissa usi jagah se milta rahe.
Misaal ke taur par, har woh harf dhoondein jis ke foran baad koi ankada ho:

\matn: 'a1 b2 cc'
matn ⌕ ⣿ _ ▸(#)⣿\
Maahol ko zaroori banayein, jaise \⣿_ ▸(#)⣿\ (ek harf jis ke baad ankada ho) ya \⣿◂("$") >0 #⣿\ ("$" ke foran baad ke ankade).
Mujhe @PatternComplement se ulta karein taake maahol mana ho jaye, jaise \⣿~▸(#)⣿\ (jis ke baad ankada nahin hai).

PatternBackref.name: $~wapsi hawala
doc: $~Main wahi matn milata hoon jo ek naam wala @PatternCapture pehle hi mila chuka hai. Bas capture ka seedha naam likh dein.
Misaal ke taur par, aisa lafz dhoondein jo foran dohraya gaya ho:

\matn: 'billi billi baithi baithi'
matn ⌕ ⣿ w: (>0 _) ␣ w⣿\
Aisa seedha naam jo capture nahin hai, uski jagah ek naam wali jamaat hota hai, jaise \⣿ linebreak⣿\.

UndefinedBackreference.name: $~anjaan naam
UndefinedBackreference.explanation: $~$name naam ka koi capture ya jamaat nahin hai, is liye mere paas milane ko kuch nahin.

PatternRest.name: $~baqi
doc: $~Main matn ka baqi hissa milata hoon, jitna ho sake. Main pattern ke aakhir mein kaam aata hoon.
Misaal ke taur par, jaanchein ke koi matn hashtag hai ya nahin, yaani "#" aur uske baad kuch bhi:

\tag: '#naashta'
tag ≈ ⣿ "#" …⣿\
Mujhe kisi tay shuruaat ke baad istemaal karein, jaise \⣿"#" …⣿\ ("#" aur phir kuch bhi) ya \⣿ "Hi " …⣿\ ("Hi " aur uske baad sab kuch).

PatternCaseFold.name: $~chhota bada nazarandaz karein
doc: $~Main apne hisson ko chhote aur bade harf ka farq kiye baghair milata hoon.
Misaal ke taur par, kisi lafz ko uske harf ke chhote bade hone ka khayal kiye baghair jaanchein:

\chillao: 'SALAAM'
chillao ≈ ⣿ Aa("hello")⣿\

Mere hisson ko is tarah gher dein \⣿ Aa("hi")⣿\ (yeh "HI", "Hi" ya "hi" ko milata hai). Uske usoolon ke liye @language lagayein, jaise \⣿ Aa/tr("i")⣿\ (turki i), aur main @scope ek @PatternBackref ko bhi, jaise \⣿ Aa(w: (2 _) w)⣿\.

PatternType.name: $~pattern ki qism
doc: $~Main pattern @value ki @type hoon, jisay \p•⣿⣿: ⣿ ◌⣿\🪲 ki tarah likha jata hai.
Misaal ke taur par, ek pattern ko @name mein mehfooz karein aur kai matn par dobara istemaal karein:

\ankon: ⣿ >0 #⣿
'mere paas 3 billiyan aur 12 machhliyan hain' ⌕ ankon\
Mehfooz karne ke baad, mujhe wahan istemaal karein jahan pattern chalta ho, jaise \text ⌕ digits\🪲 ya \text ≈ digits\🪲.

MapLiteral.name: $~naqsha matn
MapLiteral.description: $~$#count[$count kunji-qeemat ke jode ka naqsha|$count kunji-qeemat ke jodon ka naqsha]
MapLiteral.doc: $~Main kunjiyon aur @values ke darmiyan ek khaas @Map hoon. Main kaise madadgaar hoon, yeh jaanne ke liye @Map dekhein.
MapLiteral.start: $~Pehle kunjiyon aur qeematon ko chalate hain

NotAKeyValue.name: $~qeemat ghaib hai
NotAKeyValue.explanation: $~Main @Map mein hoon, is liye mujhe ek qeemat chahiye.

Match.name: $~milaan
doc: $~Main sharti jaanch ka sab se shaandaar tareeqa hoon: main ek @value leta hoon, use kayi suraton se milata hoon, aur jo milti hai usko chalata hoon!
Misaal ke taur par, agar aapke paas ek @Number ho aur aap use @Text mein badalna chahein, to kuch is tarah karein:

\adad: 2
adad ???
	1: 'ek'
	2: 'do'
	3: 'teen'
	'bada!'\
Agar koi na mile, to main woh default @expression chalata hoon jo aap mujhe dein.
Main bahut se mumkina @Number, @Text, ya zyada pechida qeematon mein se kisi ek ko kisi aur cheez mein badalne mein bahut madadgaar hoon.
Aap mujhe @Boolean ya @None ke liye bhi istemaal kar sakte hain, lekin unki itni zyada surtein nahin hoti, is liye un saada qeematon ke liye main utna kaam ka nahin hoon.

@Conditional ki tarah, main bhi aapko bata deta hoon ke maine kya seekha hai. Ek surat ke andar, jis @value ko maine milaya woh usi surat ka maaloom hota hai; baad ki surat ke andar, woh pehli kisi surat ka nahin hota; aur mere default mein, woh kisi bhi surat ka nahin hota.

\jawaab•#|'': 1
jawaab ???
	1: jawaab + 1
	'ek nahin'\

Main woh suratein hata sakta hoon jo @Number, @None, ya @Text hain, ek hi tarjume se, aur doosri saada suratein bhi. Lekin jo surat kuch chalati hai woh kisi cheez ko nahin hatati, is liye mera default woh sab rakhta hai jo @value ab bhi ho sakta hai.
Match.finish: $~Theek hai, hamein aakhri qeemat mil gayi!

NumberLiteral.name: $~adad ka sidha izhaar
NumberLiteral.doc: $~Main ek khaas @Number hoon. Aap mujhe kisi bhi @language ke kisi bhi qism ke hindson se likh sakte hain. Main jo kuch kar sakta hoon woh @Number mein dekhein.

NotANumber.name: $~adad nahin
NotANumber.explanation: $~Main samajhta tha ke mujhe sab adad aate hain, lekin yeh wala nahin aata

InternalExpression.name: $~andaruni izhaar
InternalExpression.doc: $~Main ek @expression hoon jo sirf asal banane wale istemaal karte hain. Aapne mujhe kaise dhoonda? Mere baare mein aur jaanne ke liye aapko unse baat karni hogi.

NoneLiteral.name: $~khaali qeemat ka sidha izhaar
NoneLiteral.doc: $~Main @None banata hoon, yaani anokha kuch nahin @value. Un ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye @None dekhein.

Otherwise.name: $~warna
doc: $~Main dekhta hoon ke @value @None hai ya nahin, aur agar hai, to aapko is ke bajaye ek badal qeemat deta hoon.
/Misaal ke taur par, agar aapke paas aisi qeemat ho jo @Number ya @None ho sakti hai, to @Otherwise aapko ek default number dene mein madad karta hai:

\shayadNumber•#|ø: 1
shayadNumber ?? 0\

Previous.name: $~pichhla
doc: $~Main @stream ki tareekh mein peeche dekhta hoon aur aapko us ki guzri hui @values mein se ek batata hoon. Kya aapne kabhi maazi yaad rakhna chaha hai?
Main Verse ka sarkaari record rakhne wala hoon!
Misaal ke taur par, yeh dekhein ke paanch tick pehle @Time kya tha:
Dekhein, yeh 5 second tak @None rehta hai, phir achanak ek pichhla waqt aa jaata hai!
Agar aapko pichhli kai qeematein chahiye, to mujhe do teer dein, aur main number ko ginti samjhunga:
Dekhein, ab sirf ek waqt ke bajaye pichhle paanch waqt aate hain!
Main us waqt kaam aata hoon jab aap aisi performance banana chahein jo maazi par munhasir ho.

Program.name: $~program
Program.description: $~$#count[$count bayaan wala program|$count bayaanaat wala program]
doc: $~Main woh jagah hoon jahan performance shuru aur khatam hoti hai. Mere andar woh tamam kirdaar hote hain jo show ko tarteeb dete hain.
Aap jaante hain ke @Block izhaar ki ek fehrist chalata hai aur aakhri izhaar ki qeemat deta hai?
Main bhi waisa hi hoon, lekin apni @value ko jis @expression mein hoon use dene ke bajaye, main qeemat ko @Stage par rakhta hoon.
Qeemat kuch bhi ho sakti hai: @Number, @Text, ya @Boolean, @List, @Set, @Map, ya is se bhi pecheeda cheez, jaise @Phrase, @Group, ya @Stage.
Agar aap mujhe stage par dikhane ke liye qeemat nahin dete, to main aapse maang lunga.
Agar performance ke dauran koi @conflict aaye, to main woh masla dikha dunga.
Aur agar aapki performance kisi *@stream* par munhasir hai, to jab bhi woh dhaara badlegi, main dobara chalunga.
Program.unevaluated: $~jo node aapne chuna woh chala hi nahin
Program.start: $~$stream[$stream dhaara badal kar $value ho gayi!|Yeh meri pehli martaba chalne ki baari hai]

Is tarah main bhi ek dhaara hoon, magar doosre dhaaron par mabni. Kamaal hai na?

Masalan, agar aapke paas ek khel ke khilariyon ka table ho aur aap 10 ya zyada points wale khilari dhoondna chahein ke kaun jeeta:

	⎡'jeff' 'laal' 9⎦
	⎡'janet' 'neela' 7⎦
khilari ⎡?naam⎦ nuqtay ≥ 10\
Bas aise hi, mujhe jeetne walon ki qataaron ki ek list mil gayi! Bas yaad rakhein ke main table ko nahin badalta, main ek naya table banata hoon. Aapko khud tay karna hoga ke ise kahan rakhna hai.

Aap doosre @Source @UI/addSource bhi bana sakte hain, doosre @Program ke saath, aur un doosre @Program se cheezein @Borrow taake kisi aur program mein istemaal ho saken.

StructureDefinition.name: $~dhaancha
doc: $~Main aise dhaanche banata hoon jo qeematein aur functions rakhte hain. Arre, aap kaise hain? Main? Main bahut achha hoon, mujhe yeh kaam din bhar karna pasand hai.
Main is tarah kaam karta hoon:

\•pizza(
	ajza•['']
	jasaamat•#in
) (
	ƒ qeemat2() jasaamat × 10dollars/in
)

pizza(['pepperoni' 'mirchein'] 12in).qeemat2()\🪲
Dekha, yeh kaise chalta hai? Maine \Pizza\ banaya, jis ke do inputs hain, \ingredients\ (@Text ki list) aur \size\ (inch mein ek number).
Andar, @FunctionDefinition ne ek function banaya jo pizza ki qeemat nikaalta hai, farz karein ke $$10 fi inch hai.
Mujhe apne andar @FunctionDefinition rakhne ki zaroorat nahin. Main sirf inputs bhi ho sakta hoon.

\•pizza(
	ajza•['']
	jasaamat•#in
)\
Mere andar @Bind bhi ho sakta hai, taake hum qeemat pehle se nikaal saken.

\•pizza(
	ajza•['']
	jasaamat•#in
) (
	qeemat2: jasaamat × 10dollars/in
)

pizza(['pepperoni' 'mirchein'] 12in).qeemat2\🪲
Kisi function ya @value par ↑ lagayein taake woh khud dhaanche ka ho, us ki misaalon ka nahin. Phir aap dhaanche ke @name se us tak pahunch sakte hain, misaal banaye baghair.

\•hisaab() (
	↑ pai: 3.14159
	↑ ƒ murabba(n2•#) n2 · n2
)

hisaab.pai
hisaab.murabba(5)\

Agar aap pakka karna chahte hain ke koi cheez @Boolean hai, to mujhe istemaal karein, main jaanch loonga!

ConversionType.name: $~tabdeeli ki qism
doc: $~Main @Bind ke saath milkar batata hoon ke ek naam @ConversionDefinition hai. Shayad aapko mujhe istemaal karne ki zaroorat na pade, kyunke bohat kam log mujhe @value ki tarah aage dete hain, lekin agar aap karein, to main aisa dikhunga:
\jaadoo•? → '': → ? '' ⬚ ? 'haan' 'nahin'\🪲

FormattedType.name: $~saja hua matn ki qism
doc: $~Main @Bind ke saath milkar batata hoon ke ek naam @FormattedLiteral @value hai. Is tarah:
\bhookha•`…`: `Main bahut /fancy/ hoon!`\🪲
Kya aap pakka karna chahte hain ke koi cheez @FormattedLiteral qeemat hai? Yeh uska tareeqa hai.

ExceptionType.name: $~istisna
ExceptionType.doc: $~Main ek istisna ko zaahir karta hoon. Bind ko batane ka koi tareeqa nahin ke main istisna hoon, kyunke istisna sirf @Program ko rok dete hain, is liye aap unhein @values ki tarah istemaal nahin kar sakte.

FunctionType.name: $~function ki qism
doc: $~Main ek @FunctionDefinition ko zaahir karta hoon. Agar aap batana chahte hain ke @Bind mein kis qism ka function hai, to main bohat madadgaar hoon! Is tarah:
\hisaab•ƒ(a2•# b2•# c2•# d•#) #: ƒ dilchasp(a3•# b3•# c3•# d2•#) a3 + b3 + c3 + d2\🪲

ListType.name: $~list ki qism
doc: $~Mujhe @List bohat pasand hai. Main @Bind ko batata hoon ke woh kis qism ki list hain! Is tarah, main keh raha hoon ke yeh @Number ki list hai:
Main teen alag tareeqon se keh sakta hoon. Agar main koi qism na likhoon, to list kisi bhi lambai ki ho sakti hai aur kuch bhi rakh sakti hai:
\saamaan•[]: [1 'do' ø]\🪲
Agar main ek qism likhoon, to list ab bhi kisi bhi lambai ki ho sakti hai, lekin uski har cheez usi ek qism ki honi chahiye, jaise upar @Number ki list.
Aur agar main kai qismein likhoon, to iska matlab hai ke list mein bilkul utni hi cheezein hain, aur har jagah ke liye ek qism hai. Yeh do cheezon ki list hai: pehle ek @Number, phir kuch @Text.

Yeh aakhri mujhe sab se pasand hai, kyunke tab sab ko maaloom hota hai ke kya kahan hai. @ListAccess jaanta hai ke pehli cheez @Number hai aur doosri @Text, aur agar aap mujhe cheezein ghalat tadaad mein dein, ya ghalat tarteeb mein rakhein, to main bata doonga!

MapType.name: $~naqsha
MapType.description: $~$key[$key|koi bhi] se $value[$value|koi bhi] ka naqsha ki qism
doc: $~Main @Bind ko batata hoon ke naam mein kis qism ka @Map hai, yaani uski kunjiyan aur @values kin qismon ke hain. Kya aap jaante hain @Map kitna kamaal hai? Sach mein kamaal. Yeh numbers se listein banane wala naqsha hai:

NumberType.name: $~adad
doc: $~Main @Bind ko batata hoon ke naam mein @Number hai. Kya aap jaante hain @Bind kya hona chahiye? Ek @Number, kyunke number sab se behtareen hote hain.

RangeType.name: $~hadd
doc: $~Main @Bind ko batata hoon ke naam mein @Range hai, yaani do @Number hadein, aur un ke darmiyan har number.

NameType.name: $~dhaancha
doc: $~Main ek @StructureDefinition ko uske naam se zaahir karta hoon. To agar aapke paas is tarah ka dhaancha ho, to aap ek @Bind bana sakte hain jo us se bannay wala @values mehfooz kare.

\•dost(naam•'')
pakkaDost•dost: dost('Jonah')\🪲

UnknownTypeName.name: $~anjaan qism ka naam
UnknownTypeName.explanation: $~qism ke naam sirf structure ya qism ke mutaghayyar ki taraf ishaara kar sakte hain, lekin yeh qism $type ki taraf ishaara karta hai
UnknownTypeName.resolution: $~qism ki khaali jagah se badal dein

NeverType.name: $~kabhi nahin
NeverType.doc: $~Main ek aisi @type hoon jo mumkin nahin. Jaise jab aap @Is se poochhein ke koi cheez @Number hai, lekin woh kabhi number nahin ban sakti.

NoneType.name: $~khaali qism
doc: $~@None sab se behtareen khaali cheez hai, aur main un ka wafadaar numainda hoon.
\khaaliJagah•ø: ø\🪲

SetType.name: $~set ki qism
doc: $~Main @Bind ko batata hoon ke ek naam mein kisi qism ka @Set hai. @Set sab se behtareen hai, sach mein!
\anokha•{''}: {'koi cheez' 'kuchh bhi' 'koi shakhs'}\🪲

StreamDefinitionType.name: $~dhaara ki tareef ki qism
StreamDefinitionType.doc: $~Main ek aisi @stream hoon jo aap ne banayi hai, jo mumkin nahin, to aap yeh kyun parh rahe hain?

StreamType.name: $~dhaara ki qism
doc: $~Main @streams ki khoobsurti aur matlab ka jashn manata hoon… @Bind ko unhein mehfooz karne ka keh kar:
\waqt•…#ms: Time()\🪲

StructureType.name: $~structure ki qism
StructureType.doc: $~Main ek andaruni @type hoon jo default @value qismon ki qism ko zaahir karta hai.

UnknownType.name: $~anjaan
UnknownType.doc: $~Main ek aisi @type hoon jis ka abhi kisi ko pata nahin chala. Umm… kya aap jaante hain main kis ko zaahir karta hoon? Agar hum na samajh sakein to shayad aap ko batana parhe.

TextType.name: $~matn ki qism
doc: $~Main @value ki sab se shaandaar qism ki numaindagi karta hoon, @Text.
\kahani•'': 'Ek dafa ka zikr hai...'\🪲

TypePlaceholder.name: $~khaali jagah
TypePlaceholder.doc: $~Mujhe umeed hai ke main kisi din ek @type ki numaindagi karoon, bilkul jaise mera dost @ExpressionPlaceholder ek @expression ki karta hai! Kya aap mujhe faisla karne mein madad denge ke kaun si qism?

UnionType.name: $~intikhaab
doc: $~Main ek @value ki numaindagi karta hoon jo kai qismon mein se ek ho sakti hai — A ya B ya kuch aur? Main kabhi faisla nahin kar paata!
\uljhan•''|#|{ø}: 'Mujhe nahin pata!'\🪲

Unit.name: $~ikaai
doc: $~Main har woh ikaai dikhata hoon jo ek @Number ki ho sakti hai, bagair ikaai se le kar sab se mushkil ikaai tak jo aap soch sakein. Jaise kasheesh-e-saqal, misaal ke taur par:
\gravity•#m/s^2: 9.8m/s^2\🪲
Main @Bind mein nazar aata hoon, aur @Number ke foran baad bhi. Main yeh yaqeeni banata hoon ke adaad ek hi qism ke hon, aur agar na hon to zaroor bata deta hoon, kyunke shayad ghalti ho!

UnparsableType.name: $~na-parhne-laaiq
UnparsableType.doc: $~Main ek na maaloom @expression ki @type ki numaindagi karta hoon. Main tab nazar aata hoon jab aap us izhaar ko kisi kaam ke liye istemaal karne ki koshish karte hain.

VariableType.name: $~mutaghayyar ki qism
VariableType.doc: $~Main ek @TypeVariable ki jagah khada hota hoon — @value ki ek na maaloom qism — qeematon ke darmiyan tamam baat cheet mein.

CycleType.name: $~chakkar
CycleType.doc: $~Main ek aisi @value ki numaindagi karta hoon jis ki @type khud par nirbhar hai, is liye hum nahin bata sakte ke yeh kis qism ki qeemat hai.

UnknownVariableType.name: $~na maaloom mutaghayyar
UnknownVariableType.doc: $~Kabhi kabhi hum andaza lagane ki koshish karte hain ke koi cheez kis qism ki @value hai; main tab nazar aata hoon jab hamein pata nahin hota.

NotAType.name: $~ghair mutawaqqe
NotAType.doc: $~Main ek aisi @value ki numaindagi karta hoon jis ki @type woh nahin jo hum ne socha tha — jaise jab @ListAccess ko ek @Number chahiye lekin kuch aur milta hai.

NoExpressionType.name: $~koi izhaar nahin
NoExpressionType.doc: $~Main woh @type hoon jo aapko milta hai jab ek @Block mein koi @expression nahin hota. Aap jaante hain ke kam az kam ek zaroori hai, is liye ek dein!

NotEnclosedType.name: $~na structure mein, na conversion mein, na reaction mein
NotEnclosedType.doc: $~Main tab nazar aata hoon jab @This aisi jagah istemaal hota hai jahan woh theek nahin, is liye kisi ko pata nahin chalta ke woh kaunsi @value dikhata hai.

NotImplementedType.name: $~adhoora
NotImplementedType.doc: $~Jab aap @ExpressionPlaceholder istemaal karte hain, lekin yeh nahin batate ke woh kaunsi @type hain, to main woh qism hoon jo aapko milti hai. Isay theek karein!

UnknownNameType.name: $~anjaan naam
UnknownNameType.description: $~$name[$name abhi tak tayyar nahin kiya gaya|naam nahin diya gaya]
UnknownNameType.doc: $~Main ek @name ko zaahir karta hoon jo @Reference ya @PropertyReference ko nahin mila, jab hamein pata nahin hota ke aap kis ki baat kar rahe hain.

NonFunctionType.name: $~ghair-function
NonFunctionType.doc: $~Hum mein se kuch ko function ki umeed thi; main tab nazar aata hoon jab hamein function nahin milta.
